data.one_liner: An opinionated MVVM application framework with typed routing, auth, and form widgets.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive batteries-included app framework combining typed go_router navigation, MVVM state management via ViewModel and ViewModelWidget, permission handling, form components, and utility functions.
use_when: Building full-featured production apps and want a pre-built MVVM and navigation structure
You need type-safe routing using go_router_builder
You want built-in authentication hooks and feature-access control
avoid_when: You prefer a minimalist routing solution without an opinionated framework
You use alternative state management libraries like Bloc or Riverpod and do not want the ViewModel pattern
strengths: Clean separation of concerns with MVVM framework classes
Includes helpful widgets like form fields, layout components, and data grids
weaknesses: High coupling to the framework's specific architectural patterns
Requires build_runner setup for route generation
data.setup_notes: Requires adding go_router_builder and build_runner to dev_dependencies and running build_runner for route generation.

alternatives.name: go_router
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want standard declarative routing without the opinionated MVVM framework layer of flutter_slick.

alternatives.name: auto_route
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer code-generated nested routing and typed route arguments through auto_route instead.
